domain.description: Name of the libvirt domain to backup

level.description: Backup level: copy, full, inc, diff, or auto

output_dir.description: Output target directory for backup files

scratch_dir.description: Target dir for temporary scratch files

start_domain.description: Start virtual machine if it is offline

raw.description: Include full provisioned disk images in backup

workers.description: Amount of concurrent workers used to backup multiple disks. Empty string uses default.

nbd_port.description: Port used by remote NBD Service

nbd_ip.description: IP used to bind remote NBD service on

tls.description: Enable and use TLS for NBD connection

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificates used during offline backup and restore

ssh_user.description: User to authenticate against remote sshd for remote file copy

ssh_port.description: Port to connect to remote sshd for remote file copy

syslog.description: Additionally send log messages to syslog

qemu.description: Use Qemu tools to query extents

startonly.description: Only initialize backup job via libvirt, do not backup any data

printonly.description: Quit after printing estimated checkpoint size

threshold.description: Execute backup only if threshold is reached. 0 disables check.

no_sparse_detection.description: Skip detection of sparse ranges during incremental or differential backup

freeze_mountpoints.description: If qemu agent available, freeze only filesystems on specified mountpoints within virtual machine. Comma-separated list. Empty for all.

include_disks.description: Backup only disk with target dev name. List of strings like 'vda'. Empty for all disks.

exclude_disks.description: Exclude disk(s) with target dev name. List of strings like 'vda'. Empty for none excluded.

strict.description: Change exit code if warnings occur during backup operation

socketfile.description: Use specified file for NBD Server socket
